description.p: Cumulas Mail brings your email, calendar, contacts and tasks together in one fast, familiar app. It works with Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com accounts as well as any email provider that supports IMAP.

ul.li: Microsoft 365 and Outlook.com mail, calendar, contacts and To Do
Gmail, Fastmail, iCloud, Yahoo and self-hosted mail over IMAP
New mail within seconds, with notifications you can act on
Quick search across all your mail, even offline
Meeting invitations: accept, tentatively accept or decline
Remote images blocked by default to stop email tracking
Passwords and sign-ins protected by your system keyring

description.p: To show new mail as it arrives, IMAP accounts keep a connection open to their mail server. For Microsoft accounts, Microsoft notifies the Cumulas push service (sync.cumulas.co) when the Inbox or calendar changes, and the service passes that on to the app; it never receives a token for the mailbox, and notifications carry no message or event content. The push service can be turned off in Settings, and the Inbox is then checked every 30 seconds. Cumulas Mail has no telemetry.

Closing the window keeps Cumulas Mail running in the background so that new mail still shows up, and it can start at login; both can be changed in Settings. To quit, choose Quit in the main menu or the tray icon's menu.
Cumulas Mail is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.
